name: A HARDER DAY'S NIGHT!
source:
Now with more choices than ever before, a plethora of unique dialogue to truly customize YOUR Beatles experience! Will you be friendly, or will you insult them at every turn? IT IS UP TO YOUUUUUU!!!!

March of 1964: the FABULOUS BEATLES have gone WORLDWIDE, hot off their first phenomenal USA visit last month. Now back in England, play as a Pop Weekly reporter assigned to accompany the boys for the next few days!

(This game takes place in the universe of the "A Hard Day's Night" film, but is not a direct adaptation. Just imagine that instead of filming their movie at this time, they're doing regular band stuff.)

[From [url=https://brummelliana.itch.io/ahdn-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
现在有比以往更多的选择，大量独特的对话，真正定制你的甲壳虫乐队体验！你会友好地对待他们，还是会处处侮辱他们？这取决于你！！！！

1964年3月：FABULOUS BEATLES已走向世界各地，上个月他们首次在美国进行了精彩的访问。现在回到英格兰，扮演流行周刊记者，在接下来的几天里陪伴孩子们！

（这款游戏发生在电影《A Hard Day's Night》的宇宙中，但并不是直接改编。想象一下，他们此时不是在拍摄电影，而是在做常规的乐队活动。）

[来自[url=https://brummelliana.itch.io/ahdn-demo]itch.io[/url]]
